sec-alert-bot: [31mALERT[0m Build-time scanner detected a suspicious PyPI package `rwnlib` during today's image builds. Package includes a postinstall hook that drops an executable into /usr/local/bin. We automatically quarantined images from CI job ids 4521-4525 and disabled artifact publishing.

anna (security): Summary: likely typosquat of `redwoodlib`. No evidence yet of customer data exfil or production compromise, but treat build artifacts as tainted until we finish triage. Immediate steps: 1) pause auto-deploys (mike) for images built between 2026-03-23T02:10:00Z and 2026-03-23T02:45:00Z; 2) rotate CI deploy credentials and any runner-scoped tokens (jen); 3) rebuild base images from scratch on isolated runners (mike); 4) run indicator hunt across build logs/artifacts (zoe/sam). I'll lead comms if we need internal or customer notices.

mike (build): Release pipelines for affected tags paused. I'm listing affected image digests now. We use both `CI_DEPLOY_KEY` and repo-level `ACTIONS_TOKEN` in infra; which ones should I rotate first?

anna (security): Prioritize CI_DEPLOY_KEY and the SA key used by the image-builder VM. Also rotate any runner-level OIDC audience tokens if in use. Example commands (ops only):

```
# delete github deploy key
gh api --method DELETE /repos/redwood/infra/deploy-keys/XXXX --header "Authorization: token $GH_ADMIN_TOKEN"
# remove repo secret
gh secret delete CI_DEPLOY_KEY --repo redwood/infra
# delete GCP SA key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

jen (infra): Rotating builder VM service account keys now. I'll also rotate the runner's ephemeral token provider secret and report back.

zoe (eng-oncall): Starting indicator search across build logs for suspicious exec patterns: `curl http`, `nc `, `bash -c`, `chmod 755 /usr/local/bin`, and any unexpected outbound TLS connections at build time. Will share any hits.

sam (sre): I'll check runtime clusters for nodes that pulled these images before quarantine. Use `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.status.containerStatuses[*].image}{"\n"}{end}' | grep <digest>'` to find usages.

mike (build): Kicked off clean rebuilds on an isolated pool (no cache, pinned pip index to internal mirror). New tags `base:20260323-rebuild-1` and `platform:20260323-rebuild-1`. Will only push after binary checksums verified.

devops-bot: Workflows disabled for repos: infra, platform, inference-service. Tag `security-hold-1876559999` applied to affected releases.

anna (security): Action owners: mike -> rebuild and validate binaries (check checksums + binaries list), jen -> rotate keys & confirm no new keys were minted, zoe & sam -> hunt logs & runtime usage, myself -> draft internal sec bulletin and customer notification template if we confirm exposure. Post small, factual updates here. If you find suspicious commits or artifact hashes, paste the commit/id (no secrets). :lock: :mag:
